title: Two Sum with a Dictionary
hints: A dictionary lookup is O(1). What should the keys and values be?
Map each value you've already seen to its index. For each number, check whether `target - n` has been seen **before** storing `n`.
`if let j = seen[target - n] { return [j, i] }; seen[n] = i` inside `for (i, n) in nums.enumerated()`.
